claims.quote: Mutations in STX1B encoding the presynaptic protein syntaxin-1B are associated with febrile seizures with or without epilepsy.
Mutations in STX1B encoding the presynaptic protein syntaxin-1B are associated with febrile seizures with or without epilepsy.

claims.object_text: RMT, input-output curves of MEP amplitude, SICI and ICF
claims.quote: RMT, and input-output curves of MEP amplitude, SICI and ICF revealed no significant differences between STX1B mutation carriers and healthy controls.

claims.object_text: normal motor cortical GABAAergic and glutamatergic excitability
claims.quote: Findings suggest normal motor cortical GABAAergic and glutamatergic excitability in currently asymptomatic STX1B mutation carriers.
